영어: Scene 1
1.One Hundred Sheep

A shepherd had many sheep. 
 He had one hundred sheep.
한글:
한 목자가 많은 양을 가지고 있었어요. 
 그는 양 백 마리를 가지고 있었어요.

영어:
He loved every single sheep. 
 Every day he took care of them.
한글:
그는 모든 양을 사랑했어요. 
 매일 그는 양들을 돌보았어요.

영어:
He gave them grass to eat. 
 He gave them water to drink.
한글:
그는 양들에게 풀을 먹였어요. 
 그는 양들에게 물을 주었어요.

영어: He kept them safe at night.
The shepherd was a very good shepherd.
Scene 2
2.One Sheep Was Lost

One day, the sheep walked far away. 
 They walked over hills and fields.
한글:
어느 날, 양들이 멀리까지 걸어갔어요. 
 그들은 언덕과 들판을 넘어갔어요.

영어: One little sheep walked away from the others.
한글: 한 작은 양이 다른 양들에게서 멀어졌어요.

영어:
It did not mean to get lost. 
 But soon, it could not find its way back.
한글:
양은 길을 잃으려고 한 것이 아니었어요. 
 하지만 곧, 그 양은 돌아가는 길을 찾을 수 없었어요.

영어:
The little sheep looked around. 
 It did not see the other sheep.
한글:
작은 양이 주위를 둘러보았어요. 
 다른 양들이 보이지 않았어요.

영어: The little sheep was all alone.
Scene 3
3.The Sheep Was Scared
The little sheep felt scared.

The sky was getting dark. 
 The wind blew through the trees.
한글:
하늘이 점점 어두워졌어요. 
 바람이 나무 사이로 불었어요.

영어: The sheep did not know where to go.

It could not find any grass to eat. 
 It could not find water to drink.
한글:
먹을 풀도 찾을 수 없었어요. 
 마실 물도 찾을 수 없었어요.

영어:
The little sheep began to cry. 
 “Baa, baa,” it cried softly.
한글:
작은 양이 울기 시작했어요. 
 “매애, 매애” 작게 울었어요.

영어: Scene 4
4. The Shepherd Counted His Sheep
That evening, the shepherd counted his sheep.

“One, two, three,” he counted. 
 He counted all the way to ninety-nine.
한글:
“하나, 둘, 셋” 그가 세었어요. 
 그는 아흔아홉까지 세었어요.

영어: Then he stopped and looked again.
One sheep was missing!

The shepherd felt very worried. 
 “Where is my little sheep?” he asked.
한글:
목자는 매우 걱정이 되었어요. 
 “내 작은 양이 어디 있지?” 그가 물었어요.

영어: He decided to go and find it.
Scene 5
5.The Shepherd Searched
The shepherd left the other ninety-nine sheep.
한글: 목자는 다른 아흔아홉 마리를 두고 떠났어요.

영어: He went out into the dark night.

He walked over the hills. 
 He walked through the valleys.
한글:
그는 언덕을 넘어 걸었어요. 
 그는 골짜기를 지나 걸었어요.

영어: He called out, “Little sheep, where are you?”
He looked behind rocks and bushes.

He did not give up. 
 The shepherd kept looking and looking.
한글:
그는 포기하지 않았어요. 
 목자는 계속 찾고 또 찾았어요.

영어: Scene 6
6.The Shepherd Found the Sheep

Then the shepherd heard a small sound. 
 “Baa, baa,” the sound said.
한글:
그때 목자는 작은 소리를 들었어요. 
 “매애, 매애” 소리가 났어요.

영어: The shepherd ran toward the sound.

There was his little lost sheep! 
 The shepherd felt so happy.
한글:
거기에 잃어버린 작은 양이 있었어요! 
 목자는 정말 기뻤어요.

영어:
He picked up the sheep gently. 
 He put it on his shoulders.
한글:
그는 양을 부드럽게 안아 들었어요. 
 그는 양을 자기 어깨에 올렸어요.

영어: “I am so glad I found you,” he said.
Scene 7
7.A Happy Celebration
The shepherd carried the sheep home.
한글: 목자는 양을 어깨에 메고 집으로 돌아갔어요.

영어: He called all his friends together.

“Come and celebrate with me!” he said. 
 “I found my little lost sheep.”
한글:
“나와 함께 기뻐해 줘요!” 그가 말했어요. 
 “내 잃어버린 양을 찾았어요.”

영어: Everyone was happy together.

God is like the good shepherd. 
 God loves every single person.
한글:
하나님께서는 좋은 목자와 같으세요. 
 하나님께서는 모든 사람을 사랑하세요.

영어: God is happy when even one is found.
